output.rationale: The requirement specifies the general arrangement of switchgear breaker and auxiliary units as indicated in the contract documents. The candidate product 'CROWN-ARMV' from the CROWN business unit is an engineered-to-order (ETO) arc-resistant metal-clad medium-voltage switchgear lineup, which aligns with the specification for metal-clad switchgear. This product is suitable for the requirement as it provides the necessary features and compliance with IEEE standards.
